Brookfield raised USD 77.00 billion through second-quarter fundraising, while Brookfield Asset Management stock gained 1.54 percent to EUR 40.93 at Lang & Schwarz on October 9, 2026. In its October 8, 2026 transcript, Benzinga reported that fee-related earnings reached USD 808.00 million, up 20.00 percent year over year.

What made the quarter notable?

The fundraising figure was accompanied by distributable earnings of USD 707.00 million, a 15.00 percent year-over-year increase. Fee-bearing capital reached USD 672.00 billion, up 19.00 percent over the last 12 months, according to Benzinga.

The quarter also included a USD 40.00 billion Just Group mandate and year-to-date fundraising of USD 98.00 billion. Management said the company expects 2026 to be a record year, while describing AI infrastructure, real assets and credit as key growth areas.

Next date for shareholders

Yahoo Finance lists November 6, 2026, as the estimated next earnings date for Brookfield Asset Management. Its market data also showed a USD 56.50 average analyst target and a 4.52 percent forward dividend yield on October 9, 2026.

Stock price and investor perspective

The Lang & Schwarz price of EUR 40.93 was up 1.54 percent versus the prior close of EUR 40.31 on October 9, 2026 at 4:30 p.m. CEST. The primary listing is on the NYSE, where Brookfield Asset Management was quoted at USD 45.85 at 10:32 a.m. EDT on October 9, 2026.
